own_solution.law: Ideal-transformer current ratio I_p/I_s = N_s/N_p with Joule heating I^2 R in each winding; I_s = P_load/V_load
assumptions: magnetising current, leakage and core loss negligible (stated)
load voltage held at 24 V rms (stated)

notes: I_s = 480/24 = 20 A, I_p = 2 A; losses 2^2 x 3 = 12 W plus 20^2 x 0.05 = 20 W = 32 W. Equivalently 0.08 I_s^2. With 620 W at 24 V: I_s = 25.833 A, loss = 0.08 x 667.36 = 53.39 W. Extra 140 W read as the power drawn by the extra load at the held 24 V. TA1EB and T3C5C carry no number (D anyway).
